input.title: NatWest Markets Securities joins FICC GSD as Sponsoring Member
input.summary: DTCC notice GOV2285-26 announces that NatWest Markets Securities Inc. has become a new Sponsoring Member of FICC's Government Securities Division (Omnibus CIL – GSD #94GR), expanding the pool of GSD sponsored-clearing participants.
evidence_quotes: New Sponsoring Member of the Government Securities Division of FICC: Natwest Markets Securities Inc. / Omnibus Cil – GSD #94GR
Updates/changes impacting DTCC Participant(s)/Member(s) and/or Sponsored Member(s) noted here.
input.notes: DTCC official notice confirming a new Sponsoring Member onboarding to GSD, directly relevant to GSD Sponsored volume growth (FICC-GSD-03). Reach set to 1/business_line rather than market_wide as this is a single new entrant; NatWest Markets Securities is a notable dealer but the notice is summary-only with no volume or market-wide impact stated. Effect date set to announced_date as no separate effective date is given.
